annotations.title: Statement of truth wording (CPR Part 22, PD 22, FPR Part 17)

description: Gives the exact wording of a statement of truth in England and Wales for the document and the person signing, copied word for word from its source and cited to the paragraph: statements of case and application notices (PD 22 para 2.1, naming the party where a legal representative, company officer or litigation friend's representative signs, or in a separate document under para 2.5), witness statements (PD 32 para 20.2, with the PD 57AC confirmation and certificate in the Business and Property Courts), expert reports (PD 35 para 3.3), certificates of service (Form N215), certificates of suitability (CPR 21.5(4), an adaptation, labelled so), signers unable to read (PD 22 para 2.4), costs budgets (PD 22 para 2.3), and family statements of case and witness statements (PD 17A). Says where a document takes a certificate, not a statement of truth (disclosure statements, the PD 57AD Disclosure Certificate, the Precedent F bill certificates, the N260 certificate), and gives that wording, with points to check on signing, each citing its rule.

bpc.description: "witness-statement": a trial witness statement in the Business and Property Courts, adding the PD 57AC confirmation and certificate.

doc.description: The document: "statement-of-case" (or application notice; set docName), "witness-statement", "expert-report", "certificate-of-service" (Form N215), "certificate-of-suitability" (of a litigation friend, Form N235), "unable-to-read" (the signer cannot read or sign, PD 22 para 2.4), "disclosure-statement" (standard disclosure, CPR 31.10), "bpc-disclosure-certificate" (Business and Property Courts, PD 57AD), "costs-budget" (Precedent H), "bill-of-costs" (Precedent F certificates), "statement-of-costs" (Form N260), "family-statement-of-case" (FPR, or application; set docName), "family-witness-statement" (FPR).

funding.description: "bill-of-costs": the work was done "private" (by a legal representative, other cases; the default), "employed" (by an employed legal representative), "legal-aid" (under legal aid), for Precedent F certificate (1).

party.description: The party the wording names, where a legal representative or company officer signs a statement of case, and on an N260 (the party claiming the costs): civil "claimant", "defendant", "applicant", "respondent", "Part 20 claimant", "Part 20 defendant" (default "claimant"); family "applicant", "respondent".

separate.description: The statement of truth is in a separate document (PD 22 para 2.5; PD 17A para 2.3): statements of case and witness statements only.

signer.description: Who signs; each document takes only some, and leaving it out gives the document's first: "self" (the party, personally), "legal-rep" (the party's legal representative), "company" (an officer for a company, partnership or other organisation), "litigation-friend" (the litigation friend), "lf-legal-rep" (the legal representative, for a party with a litigation friend), "witness" (the witness), "expert" (the expert), "server" (the person signing a certificate of service), "authorised-person" (the authorised person, for a signer unable to read or sign), "receiving-party" (the receiving party or its solicitor).
